official_authority.exact_section: MGLc94C§21 retained large-print direction clause beginning Upon the request of an elderly person
official_authority.official_clause_checked: Upon the request of an elderly person, as defined in section fourteen of chapter nineteen A or a person visually impaired, directions on the label affixed by the pharmacist to a container of a prescription drug shall be typed in a print size allowing no more than ten characters per inch.
official_authority.effective_date_or_version: Current posted codified text reviewed2026-11-03 with Acts2025Ch16§§7,27 effective2026-01-01; historic commencement of unchanged large-print clause unknown. Unamended codified webpage paragraph numbers not used as current operative locator.
official_authority.retrieval_provenance: Existing same-day primary evidence independently re-read as primary text by its author; fresh same officialURL read during Wave12 confirmed retained clause. No source author-report conclusion used as law.

errata.original_field_value: 247CMR9.18(5)(b)–(c); MGLc94C§21 first-paragraph visually-impaired label provision(request-dependent,not automatic for every difficulty)
errata.corrected_field_value: 247CMR9.18(5)(b)–(c); MGLc94C§21 retained large-print direction clause beginning Upon the request of an elderly person(request-dependent,not automatic for every difficulty)
errata.author_reason_ko: large-print 요청 조항을 first paragraph라고 잘못 가리켰다. 공식 원문에서 Upon the request...로 시작하는 별도 조항이며 Acts2025Ch16§7은 원래 첫 문단만 두 문단으로 교체한다. 숫자 문단 위치 대신 유지된 조항의 고유 첫 문구로 정확히 식별한다. 요청에 따른 큰 글씨 방향과 원래 정답·법적 판단은 변하지 않는다.
